answer: A VDF forces each agent to solve a sequential cipher whose depth grows with elapsed blocks, so forgery cost scales superlinearly in attacker count. A ZK-SNARK proves correct VDF evaluation without revealing the witness, letting nodes bridge hardness and privacy. This forms a cost ridge separating honest participation from profitable deviation. Since bonded stake S is slashed on double-spend, an attacker holding fraction f gains f·G − S·P(caught), negative below honest-majority, giving a Nash equilibrium where Sybil creation is unprofitable.
